core.title: Rim Exit Device, Corbin Russwin ED5200110957613CT7B

text.description_html:
Rim Exit Device, Corbin Russwin ED5200110957613CT7B

ED5000 Series pushpad exit devices are ideal for environments that require durable and attractive security solutions that will last the life of the building. Available in rim, mortise, surface vertical rod, and concealed vertical rod configurations, these exit devices exceed ANSI/BHMA Grade 1 requirements for cycle and strength, and are aesthetically pleasing, and are offered in a full range of trim designs.

Features and Specifications Rim Exit Device, Corbin Russwin ED5200:

  • ANSI/BHMA A156.3, Grade 1
  • NFPA 101 Compliant
  • UL 305 - Standard for Panic Hardware
  • Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Compliant
  • UL-cUL Listed for use on fire doors having a rating up to and including 3-hours
  • Door Height: 96"
  • Door Thickness (Standard): 1 3/4"
  • Maximum Door Width: 48"
  • Minimum Door Thickness: 1 3/4"
  • Minimum Door Thickness: 1 3/4"
  • Push Bar Length: 18"
  • Exterior Trim: Museo Salvador Lever
  • Exterior Trim Function: Nightlatch
  • Exterior Trim Cylinder: LFIC 7 Pin with Temporary Construction Core
  • Finish: Dark Oxidized Satin Bronze

Sold Individually. Special Ordered Item. NO RETURNS
